validation_queries.description: HIP API regions collected (transpose 2x100: setup + launch calls)
validation_queries.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM regions WHERE category = 'rocm_hip_api';

validation_queries.description: No HIP API regions with a null name
validation_queries.error_message: Found rocm_hip_api regions with null names
validation_queries.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM regions WHERE category = 'rocm_hip_api' AND name IS NULL;

validation_queries.description: No HIP API regions with zero duration
validation_queries.error_message: Found rocm_hip_api regions with zero duration
validation_queries.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM regions WHERE category = 'rocm_hip_api' AND duration = 0;

validation_queries.description: marker_api excluded by the domain filter
validation_queries.error_message: OVER-COLLECTION: rocm_marker_api regions present though --rocm=hip,kernel did not request them
validation_queries.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM regions WHERE category = 'rocm_marker_api';

validation_queries.description: hsa_api excluded by the domain filter
validation_queries.error_message: OVER-COLLECTION: rocm_hsa_api regions present though --rocm=hip,kernel did not request them
validation_queries.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM regions WHERE category = 'rocm_hsa_api';

validation_queries.description: Kernel launch APIs present to correlate against (~1 per kernel)
validation_queries.error_message: Fewer than 100 hipLaunchKernel-family regions for a 2x100x50 run
validation_queries.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM regions WHERE category = 'rocm_hip_api' AND name LIKE '%LaunchKernel%';

validation_queries.description: All HIP API regions have well formed timings
validation_queries.error_message: Found rocm_hip_api regions whose end timestamp precedes their start
validation_queries.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM regions WHERE category = 'rocm_hip_api' AND end < start;

validation_queries.description: transpose kernel dispatches captured (2 threads x 100 iterations)
validation_queries.error_message: transpose kernel count outside expected range for a 2x100x50 run
validation_queries.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM kernels WHERE name LIKE 'transpose%';

validation_queries.description: No kernels with a null name
validation_queries.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM kernels WHERE name IS NULL;

validation_queries.description: All kernel timings are well formed
validation_queries.error_message: Found kernels whose end timestamp is not after their start
validation_queries.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM kernels WHERE end <= start;

validation_queries.error_message: Found duplicate ids in the kernels table
validation_queries.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT id, guid, COUNT(*) c FROM kernels GROUP BY id, guid HAVING c > 1);
